definitions.explanation: A person who composes haiku poetry.

examples.japanese: {松尾|まつお}{芭蕉|ばしょう}は{有名|ゆうめい}な{俳人|はいじん}だ。
examples.english: Matsuo Basho is a famous haiku poet.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{現代|げんだい}の{俳人|はいじん}として{活躍|かつやく}している。
examples.english: She is active as a contemporary haiku poet.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}くの{俳人|はいじん}がこの{地|ち}を{訪|おとず}れた。
examples.english: Many haiku poets have visited this place.

notes:
{俳人|はいじん} refers to a poet who specializes in {俳句|はいく} (haiku).

FAMOUS {俳人|はいじん}:
- {松尾|まつお}{芭蕉|ばしょう} (Matsuo Basho) - Edo period
- {与謝|よさ}{蕪村|ぶそん} (Yosa Buson) - Edo period
- {小林|こばやし}{一茶|いっさ} (Kobayashi Issa) - Edo period
- {正岡|まさおか}{子規|しき} (Masaoka Shiki) - Meiji period

RELATED TERMS:
- {俳句|はいく}: haiku
- {歌人|かじん}: waka/tanka poet
- {詩人|しじん}: poet (general term)
